Event

Pokémon Night Out 2026 - London

Tue, Nov 10, 2026, 6:00 PM UTC → Tue, Nov 10, 2026, 10:30 PM UTC (the same moment worldwide)

The Pokémon Night Out concert at London's O2 Arena (Nov 10) comes with Pokémon GO bonuses for people at the venue.

COUNTDOWN & ADD TO CALENDAR

At the venue

  • Pikachu in one-star raids and Gengar in three-star raids. Both can be shiny, and Pokémon caught from these raids get a location background for the event.
  • Lure Modules last one hour (not Golden Lures).
  • Open the game at the venue for up to two Timed Research, with Toxtricity encounters (Amped or Low Key form) and a Pokémon Night Out baseball jersey for your avatar.

Good to know

  • If you already got the jersey research from the Los Angeles Twitch stream, you won't get that same research again.
  • The exact hours for the in-game bonuses haven't been confirmed; the venue opens around 6 p.m.

Tip

You need to be at the venue; these bonuses aren't worldwide.
